facts.raw_span: primigravid patient in their 20s during the eighth month of gestation
history of regular nonexertional episodic palpitations that lasted for a few minutes and subsided spontaneously over the past several days
no associated sweating, syncope, dyspnoea, orthopnoea, or paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea
visible neck pulsation was noticed by the patient's mother
no chronic medical comorbid conditions
not taking any medications

jugular venous pulsations revealed regular cannon waves

2-dimensional transthoracic echocardiography showed good biventricular function and normally functioning valves
